detailed_description: The Image to PDF tool converts PNG, JPEG, JPG, and WebP images into a single PDF in your browser. It uses pdf-lib to create one PDF page for each uploaded image, scales each image to fit the selected page, and centers it inside the chosen margin. You can reorder images with up and down buttons, remove images, choose A4, Letter, or Fit to Image page size, set portrait or landscape orientation for fixed page sizes, adjust the margin, and choose the output file name. This is useful for turning screenshots, receipts, diagrams, or photo scans into a simple PDF document.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and select one or more PNG, JPEG, JPG, or WebP images
Review the image list and use the up or down buttons to set the page order
Remove any image you do not want to include
Choose A4, Letter, or Fit to Image page size
Set orientation, margin, and output file name
Click Convert to PDF to create and download the PDF
usage_examples: Combine receipt photos into a single PDF for reimbursement
Turn screenshots into a PDF handout for a support ticket
Create a simple PDF from scanned form images
Arrange diagrams or reference images into one shareable file
